text: Engram tool-surface table drift in .claude/instructions.md: the 'Available Tools' table lists stale/legacy tool names (create_task, update_task, query_changes) and omits canonical engram tools (list_symbols, impact_analysis, sync_workspace, index_workspace, query_graph). Dedicated docs/memory compaction pass: docs/memory holds 52 files, over the 40-file compact-context threshold (historical residue from prior units). Non-blocking. Run compact-context (target docs/memory) to consolidate durable knowledge into the docs root and archive verbose originals to docs/archive/.

Backlogit active->queued transition-guard hardening: a shipment (observed on 103-S during the Ship-101s memory note) stayed 'queued' because the build loop never committed an 'active' claim; recovery required a manual archived-status surgical fix. Add a guard/invariant so an in-progress build reliably records the active claim, or so the queued-with-active-work inconsistency is detected and self-repaired instead of requiring a manual fix.
